messages:
kevin (oncall): noticing a spike of 5xxs from us-east -> eu-central around 14:07 UTC, a lot of LB retries and DNS SERVFAILs in the logs. opening thread to triage.
alex (eng-net): digging in edge-dns, we started enforcing the new per-client qps caps at ~14:00 for eu-central. hit the limiter for several upstream IP ranges, queries dropped and healthcheck traffic retried.
maria (sre): tracing shows retries piled up for ~25s, error budget impact ~2.8% for affected zone. endpoint fallbacks kicked in but caused extra latency.
jenny (netops): that was the "dns-qps-safety" rollout from this morning (14:00). it's scoped to reduce noisy customers; we set burst to 20 and steady qps to 5.
alex (eng-net): the problem is our LB healthchecks come in short, high-frequency bursts with no jitter; they exceed the burst window and look like abusive clients. also noticed lb service records have 10s TTL which amplified refetches.
kevin (oncall): immediate asks: can we revert to previous limiter values or widen burst for healthchecks, and raise TTLs for LB records temporarily?
jenny (netops): I can widen burst to 100 and qps to 15 for eu-central now, and follow up with a targeted rollback if needed. doing patch.
deploy-bot: config-change 2026-11-18T14:12Z "dns-qps-safety" patched in eu-central by netops.
maria (sre): monitoring shows errors subsiding beginning 14:14 UTC. recording logs and timeline for postmortem.
alex (eng-net): longer-term: propose 1) healthcheck jitter + token-bucket exemption for verified healthcheck CIDRs, 2) raise LB record TTLs to 60s for most clusters, 3) staging canary for future limiter rollouts, and 4) add an automated load sim for limiter interactions.
kevin (oncall): owners: jenny -> emergency threshold bump (done), alex -> healthcheck jitter + exemption PR by EOD (owner + ETA), jenny/alex -> TTL bump + runbook note (by tomorrow), maria -> create alert and retro ticket (COB) referencing recurrence.
maria (sre): creating retro ticket INF-4802 and linking this thread and previous incidents where limiter interactions caused user-facing retries. tagging: alex, jenny, kevin.
ajex (eng-net): (typo) alex: I'll open the PR for jitter/exemption tests and the canary plan. target PR in staging today.
jenny (netops): scheduling a focused review of limiter tuning across regions next week. will add gate checklist to rollout process.
maria (sre): confirm mitigated at 14:20 UTC; errors back to baseline. saving graphs to ticket.
kevin (oncall): please add owners/ETAs into the ticket and ping when PRs merged. closing incident thread once follow-up tickets in place. thanks all. :thumbsup:
